status: labelled PRIORS, not calibrated. Every threshold below decides only whether a diagnosis is shown for review. None of them changes a value, a rank, a lineup or a recommendation to transact.

why.quartileFraction: A 'top' or 'bottom' position rank is the league's top or bottom quarter, ceil(n x 0.25), so it scales with team count instead of a fixed rank.
why.minOwnedWeeks: Fewer owned weeks is too small a sample to call a player low-contribution.
why.lowContributionStartRate: Below this share of eligible owned weeks in the optimal lineup a player is tagged low_contribution (descriptive only).
why.developmentalMaxAge: Age at or below which a low-start player is read as developmental rather than redundant. Per-position prior, not an age cliff.
why.veteranMinAge: Age at or above which a starting player is tagged productive_veteran. Per-position prior, not an age cliff.
why.thinCoverageMinHoles: Dedicated-slot holes (unfilled or 0-point starter weeks) at or above which thin coverage is considered.
why.contenderBenchMinCount: Count of never-started, never-league-startable owned players at or above which a PUSH team's bench is flagged for review.
why.redundantMarginalPerOwnedWeekMax: Marginal optimal-lineup points per eligible owned week at or below which a top-quartile-value player is called lineup-redundant on THIS roster.
